building_navigation_guide.entrance: When you enter the building, Wing A is on your right hand side and Wing B is on your left hand side.
building_navigation_guide.stairs_upper_floors: After climbing the stairs to the 1st, 2nd or 3rd floor, Wing A will be behind you and you will be facing Wing B. When facing Wing A, the right side is Wing A Right and the left side is Wing A Left (the wing is partitioned).
